e.body: 美国农业部风险管理局（USDA Risk Management Agency, RMA，`rma.usda.gov`）是**美国联邦农作物保险计划的官方管理机构**，也是**全球规模最大的农业保险体系的政策与数据来源**。可核实的关键板块：**Policy & Procedure（政策与程序）**——发布保险政策、程序与**精算通告（Actuarial Release，如 26-022 号）**，即费率与条款的正式变更依据；**Summary of Business**——逐作物/州/年度的**承保面积、保费与赔付经验数据**（农业保险精算分析的标准数据源）；另有 Margin Protection 等具体产品页、About RMA 与官方公告。对 RIAA：这是**农险方向唯一体量足够、且带精算口径的一手来源**——「政策 → 费率（精算通告）→ 经验数据（Summary of Business）」三段齐全，正好是做农险定价、赔付率分析与巨灾情景研究所需的完整链路；与本 wiki 的农险相关词条形成互补：中国侧的 **[[china-agrore]]**（国家农业再保险）与 **[[moa-data]]**（农业数据），技术侧的 **[[agrisky-ai]]**（农险查勘定损 agent，用遥感做定损）与 **[[earth-engine]]**；参数化产品设计见 [[parametric-insurance-demo]]，气候与巨灾侧见 [[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[catmodeling]]、[[ml-drought]]、[[un-spider-radar-flood-mapping]]；行业基准见 [[swiss-re-sigma]]、[[perils-ied]]；适合作农险、参数化产品与巨灾农业风险方向。
e.body_en: The USDA Risk Management Agency (RMA, `rma.usda.gov`) is **the official administrator of the US federal crop insurance programme** and the policy and data source for **the world’s largest agricultural insurance system**. Its verifiable sections include: **Policy & Procedure** — issuing policies, procedures and **Actuarial Releases** (e.g. release 26-022), the formal basis for rate and term changes; **Summary of Business** — **insured acreage, premium and indemnity experience data by crop, state and year** (the standard dataset for crop insurance actuarial analysis); plus product pages such as Margin Protection, About RMA and official notices. For RIAA: **the only first-hand source in agricultural insurance with enough scale and an actuarial basis** — the full chain "policy → rates (actuarial releases) → experience data (Summary of Business)" is exactly what crop insurance pricing, loss-ratio analysis and catastrophe scenario work require; it complements this wiki’s agricultural entries: on the China side **[[china-agrore]]** (the national agricultural reinsurer) and **[[moa-data]]** (agricultural data), and on the technical side **[[agrisky-ai]]** (an agricultural claims agent using remote sensing for loss assessment) and **[[earth-engine]]**; for parametric product design see [[parametric-insurance-demo]], and for climate and catastrophe [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[catmodeling]], [[ml-drought]] and [[un-spider-radar-flood-mapping]]; industry benchmarks are [[swiss-re-sigma]] and [[perils-ied]]; suits agricultural insurance, parametric products and agricultural catastrophe risk.
e.body_hk: 美國農業部風險管理局（USDA Risk Management Agency, RMA，`rma.usda.gov`）是**美國聯邦農作物保險計劃的官方管理機構**，也是**全球規模最大的農業保險體系的政策與數據來源**。可核實的關鍵板塊：**Policy & Procedure（政策與程序）**——發布保險政策、程序與**精算通告（Actuarial Release）**；**Summary of Business**——逐作物/州/年度的**承保面積、保費與賠付經驗數據**；另有 Margin Protection 等產品頁與官方公告。對 RIAA：這是**農險方向唯一體量足夠、且帶精算口徑的一手來源**——「政策 → 費率（精算通告）→ 經驗數據（Summary of Business）」三段齊全；與本 wiki 的農險相關詞條互補：中國側 **[[china-agrore]]** 與 **[[moa-data]]**，技術側 **[[agrisky-ai]]** 與 **[[earth-engine]]**；參數化產品設計見 [[parametric-insurance-demo]]，氣候與巨災側見 [[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[catmodeling]]、[[ml-drought]]、[[un-spider-radar-flood-mapping]]；適合作農險、參數化產品與巨災農業風險方向。
